text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear... Are you no good with video games either, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Now, now, just knowing you did your best is enough to make me happy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, when it comes to yo-yo fishing,
it wouldn't be very interesting if you could catch them effortlessly, right?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You can always try again someday. The important thing is never giving up.
It ended in a disappointing result...
